rows.label: COMMON WASP

rows.label: GIANT CRAB

rows.label: CHLOROPHYLL

rows.label: COMMON EEL

rows.label: WATER DEER

rows.label: SONGBIRD

rows.label: COPPERHEAD

rows.label: GUARD HAIR

rows.label: UDDER

rows.label: TITMOUSE

rows.clue: Small freshwater branchiopod having a transparent body with many appendages

rows.label: SEA LOUSE

rows.label: DABBLING DUCK

rows.label: GOPHER SNAKE

rows.label: SHRIKE

rows.label: MONKEY

rows.label: RAINBOW PERCH

rows.label: TOY DOG

rows.label: VINEGAR EEL

rows.label: DIVING DUCK

rows.label: GRUBBY

rows.label: MEALY BUG
rows.clue: Scalelike plant-eating insect coated with a powdery waxy secretion

rows.label: MOLLUSK
rows.clue: Invertebrate having a soft unsegmented body usually enclosed in a shell

rows.label: SEA ANIMAL
rows.clue: Any of numerous animals inhabiting the sea including e.g. fishes and molluscs and many mammals

rows.label: TRUE FROG
rows.clue: Insectivorous usually semiaquatic web-footed amphibian with smooth moist skin and long hind legs

rows.label: SUCKING PIG
rows.clue: An unweaned piglet

rows.label: SANDPIPER
rows.clue: Any of numerous usually small wading birds having a slender bill and piping call

rows.label: SPIROCHETE
rows.clue: Parasitic or free-living bacteria

rows.label: VIREO
rows.clue: Any of various small insectivorous American birds chiefly olive-grey in color

rows.label: BOTTOM FISH
rows.clue: Fish that live on the sea bottom (particularly the commercially important gadoid fish like cod and haddock, or flatfish like flounder)

rows.label: FIELD SPARROW
rows.clue: Common North American finch of brushy pasturelands

rows.label: RAILROAD WORM
rows.clue: Larvae bore into and feed on apples

rows.label: AMNION
rows.clue: Thin innermost membranous sac enclosing the developing embryo of higher vertebrates (reptiles, birds and mammals)

rows.label: FETTER BONE
rows.clue: The part between the fetlock and the hoof

rows.label: DRONE
rows.clue: Stingless male bee in a colony of social bees (especially honeybees) whose sole function is to mate with the queen

rows.label: FEATHER STAR
rows.clue: Free-swimming stalkless crinoid with ten feathery arms

rows.label: TREE SWIFT
rows.clue: Birds of southeast Asia and East Indies differing from true swifts in having upright crests and nesting in trees

rows.label: LIGHTNING BUG
rows.clue: Nocturnal beetle common in warm regions having luminescent abdominal organs

rows.label: BEAKED WHALE

rows.label: BARK LOUSE
rows.clue: Any of several insects living on the bark of plants

rows.label: CHEETAH
rows.clue: Long-legged spotted cat of Africa and southwestern Asia having nonretractile claws

rows.label: GOPHER TURTLE
rows.clue: Burrowing edible land tortoise of southeastern North America

rows.label: MAMMOTH
rows.clue: Any of numerous extinct elephants widely distributed in the Pleistocene

rows.label: PLACENTAL

rows.label: BODY LOUSE

rows.label: CARAPACE
rows.clue: Hard outer covering or case of certain organisms such as arthropods and turtles

rows.label: YELLOWHAMMER

rows.clue: Any of various moths with long narrow forewings capable of powerful flight and hovering over flowers to feed

rows.label: SCORPION SHELL
